title: A Spot on the Sun
subtitle: 太空宇宙 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 太空宇宙（宇宙探索·太空与宇宙）
meta: 主题语境：太空宇宙（宇宙探索·太空与宇宙）　|　核心词汇：spot　|　正文 283 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 spot 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: There was a ① spot on the sun in 1974 that my grandfather drew every day for eleven weeks in a notebook, and which he said was the only thing in the sky that changed while you watched it, and the only spot he ever drew twice.

He had a ② spot on the hill behind the village — eleven minutes' walk and one gate — where the light from the town did not reach, and he took me there from the time I was four until the time I was fifteen, and never once told anybody else where the spot was.

In 1979 he was ③ on the spot, actually standing in the field, when the meteorite came down, and he was the first person in the county to touch it. He was interviewed, badly, and never forgave himself. The ④ spot where it landed is marked by nothing at all, which my grandfather said was the county's doing and not his.

The society offered him a ⑤ spot on the committee and he refused it, which my grandmother said was the only sensible thing he had ever done. He was ⑥ in a spot about the money, though, and the ⑦ spot on the radio — four minutes, once a month — he accepted, and hated.

He died in 1998. There is a ⑧ spot of rust on the telescope and I have never cleaned it. There is a brown ⑨ spot on the notebook where he put his thumb, eleven times, on the same page, and I have never cleaned that either. There is a ⑩ spot on the hill now, and it is a car park, and I have never been able to bring myself to park in it.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 斑点；污点；瑕疵
B. n. 地点；场所；位置
C. 固定搭配：a spot of ... 少量的……（a spot of tea / lunch）
D. 固定搭配：on the spot 当场；在现场；立即
E. 固定搭配：in a spot 处于困境；为难
F. n. 职位；名额；位置（a spot on the team）
G. n. （广播、电视的）节目时段；插播
H. n. （太阳）黑子；（星体上的）点（sunspot）

items.q: There was a spot on the sun in 1974
He had a spot on the hill
offered him a spot on the committee
He was in a spot about the money
There is a spot of rust
There is a brown spot on the notebook
There is a spot on the hill now

answers.why: a spot on the sun 意为“太阳黑子”，1974 年他连画了十一周，是唯一他会画第二遍的黑子。
a spot 意为“地点、位置”，他在村后山上有一个观测点，走十一分钟，过一道门。
on the spot 意为“在现场、当场”，1979 年陨石落下时他正好站在那片地里。
the spot where ... 意为“……的地点”，陨石落地的那个地点现在什么标记也没有。
a spot on ... 意为“……里的一个职位／名额”，协会给了他一个委员会的名额，他拒绝了。
in a spot 意为“处境为难、陷入困境”，不过他在钱这件事上确实为难。
a spot on the radio 意为“电台的一个节目时段”，每月一次四分钟，他接了，而且讨厌。
a spot of ... 意为“少量的……”，望远镜上有一小块锈，我一直没擦。
a spot 意为“斑点、污点”，笔记本上有一块褐色的拇指印，一共十一次，都在同一页。
a spot 意为“地点、那一块地方”，山上那个地方现在成了停车场。
